name: Agent Engineer
tagline: Design reliable tool-using agents, protocols, and orchestration.
description: A path built around the agent loop: tool interfaces, MCP, planning, memory, durable execution, evaluation, and human oversight. You cover the LLM context you need to reason about model behaviour, then spend your time on protocols, orchestration patterns, failure modes, and production runtimes.

phaseRationale.04-computer-vision: Vision model internals are not required to build tool-using agents, and multimodal agents are covered elsewhere.
phaseRationale.06-speech-and-audio: Voice agents are a separate pipeline specialization.
phaseRationale.08-generative-ai: Image and video generation is not part of agent tooling; multimodal capabilities are consumed through APIs.
phaseRationale.02-ml-fundamentals: Classical ML is useful context but agents are built on language models and tool contracts.
phaseRationale.03-deep-learning-core: You need transformer intuition, not hand-written backpropagation, to ship agents.
phaseRationale.09-reinforcement-learning: RLHF matters for model behaviour, but you will not train policies as an agent engineer.
phaseRationale.12-multimodal-ai: Multimodal agents are a growing area, but the core agent path is text and tool-first.

majorProjects: Stateless MCP server with registry and governance
